title: Silver Hunter
summary: Silver Hunter is a Meso-Titan tracker favored by Dr. Rickman. With silver fut and razor sharp fangs, it possesses exceptional hunting abilities.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Silver Hunter was summoned by Dr. Rickman at Skara Brae to hunt down the Huntik team. [Mission to Skara Brae]

Rickman invoked Silver Hunter in to attack Dante in Quimper Cathedral. After defeating Dante's Solwing, it fought against Caliban who was sent back to his Amulet by Rickman's spell. Silver Hunter knocked Dante to the floor but was turned to stone by King Basilisk before he could finish him off. [The Seekers of Ys]

Rickman summoned Silver Hunter in the underwater city of Ys, to hunt down Dante, but it was defeated by Dante's Metagolem. [The Lost City of Casterwill]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Silver Hunter is a ferocious hunter who pursue its prey with great speed and agility. It can jump great heights and attack with formidable spirit. Its fangs and claws are incredibly sharp and can rip an enemy to shreds.
